## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, connection strings, or certificates committed.
- [ ] No new public IP or public data-plane access without an approved exception.
- [ ] New Azure permissions are scoped and justified.
- [ ] Authentication and authorization changes have negative tests.
- [ ] Input validation and error handling considered.
- [ ] Dependency and image versions pinned.
- [ ] Logs do not contain tokens, PII, or full request bodies.
